title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 43 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 43)

content.overview: Section 43 applies the Limitation Act, 1963 to arbitrations as it applies to proceedings in Court. It also specifies the statutory commencement rule by reference to section 21 and contains special rules for limitation consequences following court orders relating to awards or fresh arbitration.

content.study:
Section 43 — Limitations

Section 43 applies the Limitation Act, 1963 to arbitrations as it applies to proceedings in Court. It also specifies the statutory commencement rule by reference to section 21 and contains special rules for limitation consequences following court orders relating to awards or fresh arbitration.

The section must be applied by identifying the statutory trigger, connected provisions and procedural consequence. Limitation, insolvency or jurisdictional effects must be determined from the text and applicable statute rather than assumed from general arbitration practice.
